human_policy.definition: AI-only ordinary horizontal strokes. Rear ball interference requires unsupported cue elevation and is rejected. When the rear stroke crosses a nearby rail, use only gentle high-tip strokes. Rail thresholds, shaft envelope, distance/cut limits and close-ball exclusion are conservative engineering choices, not measured professional limits. They do not alter forward physics or manual controls.

label_definition: Bounded rollout completion discounted by potting geometric tolerance first (both travel distances, cut angle and pocket entry), then ordinary position effort and cue access; small partial-progress credit. Not measured human probabilities or proof of impossibility.
